metadata.case_name: CHAN WANG LIK NICK v. LAI FOOK WAH

plaintiff.occupation_before: salaried tourist guide for Sun Flower Travel Service Ltd and part-time bar worker

injuries.description: persistent soft tissue inflammation over the back
source: the doctors agreed that the Plaintiff’s back tenderness detected was genuine and was compatible with persistent soft tissue inflammation over the back.
Medical examination revealed pain over the lumbar area but with no radiation to the lower limbs.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

source: He was referred to the Castle Peak Hospital where he was diagnosed to be suffering from Adjustment Disorder on 12 February 2007.

injuries.description: soft tissue injury / tenderness over the neck and right chest wall
source: Medical examination revealed tenderness over the neck and right chest wall.

manifestations.description: low back pain radiating to the left buttock at times
could not sleep well because of the pain
has to take analgesics once or twice a day
cannot walk or sit for over 30 minutes
cannot lift objects over 5 kgs in weight
cannot play football or go for scuba diving because of the injuries

treatments_received: Admission to the Accident and Emergency Department of Tuen Mun Hospital (treated and discharged same day)
Physiotherapy (11 sessions between June and September 2006; 10 sessions between April and July 2008; ongoing physiotherapy thereafter)
Consultation with orthopaedic specialist Dr. Poon Kai Ming
Consultation with chiropractor Dr. Vinca W T Chan
MRI scan of the lumbar spine on 2006-09-02 (no significant abnormality found)
Consultation with clinical psychologist Dr. M C Cheung (18 August 2006)
Referral to Castle Peak Hospital and treatment with antidepressant
Occupational therapy programme at Tuen Mun Hospital (23 May 2007)
Pain Centre consultation at Alice Ho Mui Ling Nethersole Hospital (29 July 2008) with medication and chronic pain management advice
treatments_future: psychological and psychiatric treatments (ongoing / as required)
orthopaedic follow-up treatments at Tuen Mun Hospital (on a need-to basis)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: cannot play football or go for scuba diving because of the injuries
cannot walk or sit for over 30 minutes
cannot lift objects over 5 kgs in weight
requires psychiatric drugs for depression and insomnia affecting quality of life
He was referred to the Castle Peak Hospital where he was diagnosed to be suffering from Adjustment Disorder on 12 February 2007.
